name: renovations
brief: A release went out on Friday and touched four tables. Reports that read these tables fail in four different ways. Find what changed in each.
hints: Four problems, one in each of four tables, all about the shape of the table rather than its values.
A column that is missing and one that is new in the same table may be one column under a new name.
One column kept its name and its content but changed what kind of value it holds.
